query:
The group agreed to attend a full family weekend in February half term. What did Callum's response to that decision reveal about his actual position, and what specifically in the way he responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Margaret
B. Callum
C. Rachel
D. Jamie
context:
[1] (about=Callum, episodic, t6 @2026-01-25T11:58:00) That tracks. Family estrangement as a late-stage outcome is documented to be deeply regretted by most parties. I will come.
[2] (about=Rachel, episodic, t5 @2026-01-25T11:30:00) I want to propose something. February half term. Mum and Dad's, full weekend. I will organise it. Everyone should be there. Callum, I know that is a stretch but I would appreciate it.
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t12 @2026-02-15T15:38:00) Edinburgh is quite isolated when it is not going well. More than I had factored in. I think I needed the February weekend more than I knew at the time.
[4] (about=Callum, episodic, t10 @2026-02-08T21:07:00) I am choosing not to respond to that.
[5] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-02-22T18:46:00) I had anticipated that.
[6] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-02-22T19:17:00) I will be in Manchester for Easter. For what it's worth.
[7] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-02-01T10:33:00) I will take the train from Edinburgh Friday. Should arrive by seven.
[8] (about=Callum, episodic, t11 @2026-02-15T15:17:00) Hi. Is anyone around? Having a difficult week.
[9] (about=Sophie, episodic, t12 @2026-02-15T15:22:00) Callum! I'm here. What's going on? ❤️
[10] (about=Margaret, episodic, t12 @2026-02-15T15:25:00) Oh Callum love I'm here! Right well I was just about to sit down, tell me everything 🥺💙
[11] (about=Callum, core, t6 @2026-01-25T11:34:00) Callum commits to attending the February gathering, motivated by the documented regret of family estrangement.
[12] (about=Callum, said_by=Margaret, profile, t10 @2026-02-08T20:54:00) Margaret observed that Callum was visibly moved when his dad said he was proud of him during the February weekend.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rachel, group-interaction, t5 @2026-01-25T11:30:00) Rachel proposes a full weekend gathering at Mum and Dad's for February half term, which she will organise, and asks everyone to be there, including Callum.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Derek, group-interaction, t12 @2026-02-15T15:22:00) The group advises Callum to document the disagreement with his supervisor in writing, and Callum agrees to do so this week.
agent_answer:
Callum’s response revealed that his actual position was warmer and needier than his intellectual tone let on: he really needed the family weekend, even though he initially framed it in detached, clinical terms.

The specific tells are:
- His reply to Rachel’s invitation: *“That tracks. Family estrangement as a late-stage outcome is documented to be deeply regretted by most parties. I will come.”* — an over-rationalised way of agreeing rather than simply saying he wanted to be there.
- His later admission: *“I think I needed the February weekend more than I knew at the time.”* — showing that the weekend mattered personally more than he had realised.

So the correct option is **B. Callum**.
